## Hypothesis

H1: Points allocated to a partner's physical attractiveness differ by sex at birth.

H2: Confidence in finding a new partner is associated with relationship commitment.

```{r load package}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrain)

```

## Load the processed data

```{r loadData}
#load processed data
h1Data <- read_csv("data/processed_data/practice_h1.csv")

h2Data <- read_csv("data/processed_data/practice_h2.csv")

#reorganize categorical variable
table(h1Data$Sex_birth)
h1Data$Sex_birth <- factor(h1Data$Sex_birth,
                           levels = c("Male", "Female",
                                      "Intersex"))
```

## H1 - Box Plot

```{r H1Box}
#Box plot
#The line is the median; the box covers the middle 50% of responses (Q1-Q3).
#Whiskers reach the most extreme observations within 1.5 IQR of the box edges.

h1_box <- ggplot( data = h1Data,
                  aes(x = Sex_birth,
                      y = preference_imp_physat,
                      fill = Sex_birth)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Sex assigned at birth", 
       y = "Points allocated to partner physical attractiveness",
       title = "Points allocated to partner physical attractiveness by sex",
       fill = "Sex") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

h1_box
```

## H1 - Violin Plot (with Box Plot)

```{r H1Violin}
#Violin Plot
#Wider sections show where responses are more concentrated within each group.
#The shape depends on smoothing; integer scores can create bumps.
#add a small boxplot at the end to see spread of data!
h1Violin <- ggplot( data = h1Data,
                  aes(x = Sex_birth,
                      y = preference_imp_physat,
                      fill = Sex_birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  labs(x = "Sex assigned at birth", 
       y = "Points allocated to partner physical attractiveness",
       title = "Points allocated to partner physical attractiveness by sex",
       fill = "Sex") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  geom_boxplot(width = .12)

h1Violin

```

## H1 - Raincloud Plot

```{r H1Raincloud}
#Raincloud Plot
#A raincloud combines a half-violin, a box plot, and individual responses.
h1Rain <- ggplot( data = h1Data,
                  aes(x = Sex_birth,
                      y = preference_imp_physat,
                      fill = Sex_birth)) +
  geom_rain(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Sex assigned at birth", 
       y = "Points allocated to partner physical attractiveness",
       title = "Points allocated to partner physical attractiveness by sex",
       fill = "Sex") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

h1Rain
  
```

## H2 - Scatter Plots

```{r H2Scatter}
#Scatter Plot
h2Point <- ggplot(data = h2Data,
                  aes(x = qoa,
                      y = commitment)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs( x = "Confidence finding alternative partner",
        y = "Commitment level",
        title = "Relationship between confidence finding alternatives and commitment level") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

h2Point

#Plot looks weird... why?
# looks weird bc this is a likert scale...set better stuff
nrow(h2Data)

#check unique data points
nrow(unique(h2Data[,c("qoa", "commitment")]))

#Jitter
h2jitter <- ggplot(data = h2Data,
                  aes(x = qoa,
                      y = commitment)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0.04, alpha = 0.04, size = 0.6) +
  labs( x = "Confidence finding alternative partner",
        y = "Commitment level",
        title = "Relationship between confidence finding alternatives and commitment level") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

h2jitter



```

## H2 - Smooth Line

```{r}
#Scatter Plot with line
h2Line <- h2jitter +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

h2Line

```

## Save figures

```{r saveFigures}
#Run after creating the plots. Save PNG files in the project's figures folder.
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("figures/H1_figure_rain.png", plot = h1Rain,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300) 
ggsave("figures/h2_figures_line.png", plot = h2Line,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
